try again on 20261031-001542-anbv. Ruling on the critic's round-3 major finding: use only a CI run whose event is `push` and whose branch is `athena/ci/<job id>`; ignore pull_request runs and runs on any other branch, even when their head SHA matches, because a pull_request run tests the candidate merged with main, not the candidate's own tree. Filter by event and branch when reading the run (crates/athena-core/src/gh/client.rs), and add a test that a newer green pull_request run for the same SHA is ignored.
Priority: urgent
